dedupe_keys.name: collection of 124 global datasets for studying floods droughts and their interactions with human societies

description: This is a descriptive catalogue of 124 free global datasets for spatial and temporal analysis of floods, droughts and their interactions with human societies, grouped into seven categories: hydrographic baseline, hydrological dynamics, hydrological extremes, land cover and agriculture, human presence, water management (such as dams and irrigation) and vulnerability. For each dataset it records the products, period, temporal and spatial resolution, extent, creators, data type, file format, whether it is based on remote sensing or ground data, its sources and which other listed datasets it is compatible with. Researchers at Uppsala University and KTH compiled it for a review paper and published it on Zenodo as one Excel file, available as a free download under CC BY 4.0 (version 1.0, August 2019). Coverage is global datasets only. Caveats: it dates from 2019, so versions and links will have moved, and it lists datasets, not holding them. Simulation uses: finding inputs for flood and drought hazard exposure and climate adaptation studies that include dams and water management. Related record: GRanD (data-grand-global-reservoir-and-dam-database).
